long_biography.plain_text:
Rocky Wirtz helped create Breakthru Beverage Group by combining the family’s drinks distributor with Charmer Sunbelt in 2016. He brought decades of operating experience to the partnership: after graduating from Northwestern University, he rose through Judge and Dolph to become its president. He had helped expand the distribution business across the United States and remained Breakthru’s co-chairman.

His family’s connection to Northwestern also shaped his support for theatre. With his wife, Marilyn, he made the gift recognised in 2014 by naming the university’s performing arts centre after his grandmother, Virginia Wadsworth Wirtz. A Northwestern graduate herself, she had helped raise funds for the original building. Later family gifts added classroom, rehearsal and performance spaces.
